description: Locations Object Structure for Apptio export.
title: LOCATIONS

plusgqualitycritical.title: Quality Critical
plusgqualitycritical.remarks: Specifies whether this location is critical for ensuring quality. If the check box is selected, this location is quality critical. If the check box is cleared, this location is not quality critical.

plusgsecegrp.title: SECE Group
plusgsecegrp.remarks: The Safety and Environmentally Critical Elements group that is associated with the location.

adjustedlifedate.title: Adjusted life
adjustedlifedate.remarks: The date that the asset reaches the adjusted useful life date. This date is calculated by plans or asset expected life.

plusgfmperson.title: Failure Analysis Leader
plusgfmperson.remarks: The person who is leading the failure analysis effort.

methodname.title: Scoring Method
methodname.remarks: The scoring method applied to the location.

plusgpermitreq.title: Permit Required
plusgpermitreq.remarks: Specifies whether a permit is required to work at this location. If the check box is selected, a permit is required. If the check box is cleared, a permit is not required.

plusgfmcomplete.title: Complete
plusgfmcomplete.remarks: The date when the failure analysis is set to be completed.

plusgarea.title: Area
plusgarea.remarks: The area that is associated with location.

pluscloop.title: Loop Calibration
pluscloop.remarks: Select this check box to identify the location as a loop calibration.

plusgfirezone.title: Fire Zone
plusgfirezone.remarks: The fire zone that is associated with this location.

purchvaracc.title: Purchase Variance Account
purchvaracc.remarks: Account used to track fluctuations in purchase costs for items (or the variance between PO and original Last and Standard price). Not used with any MAXIMO transactions. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

plusgbenchsource.title: Benchmark Source
plusgbenchsource.remarks: The source of the benchmark mean time between failures for the location. Valid values are in the PLUSGBENCHSOURCE domain.

plusgnormalopmode.title: Normal Operating Mode
plusgnormalopmode.remarks: The normal operating mode (for example, running, active, standby, or intermittent) for this location.

plusgactionsumm.title: Review Action Summary
plusgactionsumm.remarks: A summary of the review actions that are associated with the location.

plusgleakdetails.title: Leak Details
plusgleakdetails.remarks: Describes the source of the leak, and any other information about the leak.

plusqual.title: Safety Class
plusqual.remarks: Identifies whether or not this component is safety related.  (IM Important to Non-Nuclear Safety, N Non-safety Related, Q Nuclear Safety Related).

plussafediv.title: Safety Division
plussafediv.remarks: The Safety Division to which the Location belongs

plusghazareadwg.title: Hazardous Area Classification Dwg
plusghazareadwg.remarks: The identifier of a plant hazardous area classification drawing.

plusgtargetmtbf.title: Target MTBF
plusgtargetmtbf.remarks: The target mean time between failures for the location, in hours. The value must be an integer.

plusgisolevelind.title: Level 1 - Industry
plusgisolevelind.remarks: The ISO 14224 industry category. Valid values are in the PLUSGISO14224IND domain.

toolcontrolacc.title: Tool Control Account
toolcontrolacc.remarks: Default debit account for capitalized tools. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

pluscpmextdate.title: Due Date Extended
pluscpmextdate.remarks: When this check box is selected, the Extended Date on the PM for the location was set. This check box is cleared when the work order is generated.

plusgsolomonequip.title: Solomon Equipment Type
plusgsolomonequip.remarks: The Solomon equipment type for rotating equipment, fixed plant, pipe work and civil, electrical equipment, and instrumentation and controls.

plusinstchnl.title: Instrument Channel
plusinstchnl.remarks: The Instrument Channel to which the Location belongs

invoicevaracc.title: Invoice Variance Account
invoicevaracc.remarks: Debit account used to track variances in the price, expressed in the vendor's currency, between receipt and invoice for this storeroom. The transaction amount is positive when the invoice line cost is greater than the receipt cost. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

plusgpipprocessmedium.title: Process Medium
plusgpipprocessmedium.remarks: The type of medium, such as fuel or water, that the pipe is designed to carry.

intlabrec.title: Internal Labor Account
intlabrec.remarks: Used as the credit account for any internal labor transaction; it is the accrual account for the value of internal labor "issued" to work orders or other activities. For example, this is credited when internal labor usage on a work order is reported. This account is paired with the debit account in the transaction, which includes the labor resource code as a component.

plusgpiprating.title: Rating
plusgpiprating.remarks: The pressure that the pipe is designed to withstand.

bimroomname.title: Room Name/Number
bimroomname.remarks: The name or number of the room or space

expectedlife.title: Expected Life
expectedlife.remarks: Expected life of the location, expressed in years.  This value is based on the typical useful life that a manufacturer or industry standard recommends for a location or location type.

plusglastchkdate.title: Last Checked Date
plusglastchkdate.remarks: The date and time when the valve was last checked for leaks.

plusgnoropstate.title: Normal Lock State
plusgnoropstate.remarks: The lock state for this location or valve during normal operations. For example, indicates whether the location or valve is locked open or closed when operations are running normally.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: Date the Locations status was last changed.

invcostadjacc.title: Cost Adjustment Account
invcostadjacc.remarks: Account that tracks changes in either the average price or the standard price from manual inventory price adjustments. These changes result from using the Adjust Average Cost and Adjust Standard Cost actions, respectively. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

pluscduedate.title: Next Calibration Due Date
pluscduedate.remarks: Displays the date that the next calibration must be completed by.

plusgcomcrit.title: Commercially Critical
plusgcomcrit.remarks: Specifies whether this location is commercially critical. If the check box is selected, this location is commercially critical. If the check box is cleared, this location is not commercially critical.

plusghazareaclass.title: Hazardous Area Classification
plusghazareaclass.remarks: The classification that is assigned to the hazardous area in this plant. Valid values are in the PLUSGHAZARDCLASS domain.

plusglegacytag.title: Legacy Tag Number
plusglegacytag.remarks: A legacy or alternate tag number for this location. You can change this value when the location record is in any status. When this field displays in other applications, it is read-only.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Specifies the site where this location or storeroom resides.

plusgistemp.title: Temporary
plusgistemp.remarks: Indicates whether a location is only needed for a limited time. The location is tracked for historical purposes.

receiptvaracc.title: Receipt Variance Account
receiptvaracc.remarks: Debit account to track the variance between PO and Invoice exchange rates. This account contains the differences between the inventory standard cost and the receipt cost (specific to the storeroom) for any items in the associated storeroom location. It is used for standard costing only. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

plusgsldno.title: Single Line Diagram
plusgsldno.remarks: The identifier of a plant single line diagram.

useinpopr.title: Use in PO/PR
useinpopr.remarks: Specifies whether this storeroom can be used to supply and reserve inventory items and tools for use with internal purchase requisitions and internal purchase orders. If the check box is selected, you can order and reserve items or tools from this storeroom on internal POs and PRs. If the check box is cleared (the default), this storeroom cannot be used to supply items or tools internally.

plusgopcategory.title: Operation Category
plusgopcategory.remarks: The operation category (for example, remote, manned, or sub-sea) for this location.

plusgpredictedmtbf.title: Predicted MTBF
plusgpredictedmtbf.remarks: The predicted mean time between failures for the location, in hours. The value must be an integer.

plusgisolevelbus.title: Level 2 - Business Category
plusgisolevelbus.remarks: The ISO 14224 business category. Valid values are in the PLUSGISO14224BUS domain.

shrinkageacc.title: Shrinkage Account
shrinkageacc.remarks: Credit account used when manually adjusting the inventory quantity. The transaction is positive when the actual inventory quantity is greater than the MAXIMO-calculated current balance. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

plusgsafinteglev.title: Safety Integrity Level
plusgsafinteglev.remarks: The safety integrity level according to IEC61508.

plusgisolevelinstn.title: Level 3 - Installation Reference
plusgisolevelinstn.remarks: The ISO 14224 installation reference. Valid values are in the PLUSGISO14224INSTN domain.

plusgfasummary.title: Summary
plusgfasummary.remarks: A summary of the details of the failure analysis, such as which method is used.

plusrevdatetime.title: Revision Date
plusrevdatetime.remarks: The date on which the current revision was created.

oldinvcostadjacc.title: Old Invoice Cost Adjustment Account
oldinvcostadjacc.remarks: Last inventory cost adjustment account for manual inventory price adjustments.

plusgbrstate.title: Barrier State
plusgbrstate.remarks: The current state of the barrier.

plusgpiptype.title: Piping Type
plusgpiptype.remarks: The type of piping, such as process or small bore, that is used for this location.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: The description of the location. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button.

plusgenvcrit.title: Environmentally Critical
plusgenvcrit.remarks: Specifies whether this location is environmentally critical. If the check box is selected, this location is environmentally critical. If the check box is cleared, this location is not environmentally critical.

plusgtotalscore.title: Total Score
plusgtotalscore.remarks: The total score that is assigned to the review actions that are associated with the location.

plustechspec.title: Tech Spec
plustechspec.remarks: Specifies whether this location is covered by one or more LCOs (limiting conditions for operation) or equivalent regulations. You can associate the relevant tech spec records in the Associated Tech Specs table.

plusgpermittype.title: Permit Type
plusgpermittype.remarks: The type of permit that is required to perform work at this location. Valid values are in the PLUSGPERMITTYPE domain.

mrefid.title: Real Estate and Facilities ID
mrefid.remarks: External display Real Estate and Facilities id

plusgisolevelsec.title: Level 5 - Section
plusgisolevelsec.remarks: The ISO 14224 main section of the plant. Valid values are in the PLUSGISO14224SECT domain.

plusgbenchmarkmtbf.title: Benchmark MTBF
plusgbenchmarkmtbf.remarks: The benchmark mean time between failures for the location, in hours. The value must be an integer.

plusgpipreference.title: Reference
plusgpipreference.remarks: The reference to documentation or to an identifier that is associated with the type of piping that is used.

plusgpiplinenum.title: Line Number
plusgpiplinenum.remarks: The line number for the pipe.

plusgopmanualref.title: Operating Manual Reference
plusgopmanualref.remarks: The identifier of an operating manual or section of an operating manual.

plusgexatexstd.title: Ex/ATEX Standard
plusgexatexstd.remarks: The Ex/ATEX standard that applies to the location. Valid values are in the PLUSGEXATEXSTD domain. If the Ex/ATEX check box is selected, this field is required. You can change this value while the location record is in any status.

lastahscoredate.title: Last Scoring Date
lastahscoredate.remarks: The last date that health score getting updated

expectedlifedate.title: Expected EOL
expectedlifedate.remarks: The date that the location reaches the expected useful life date. This date is calculated by using the location's original installation date and its expected useful life, which is defined by manufacturer or industry standard.

type.title: Type
type.remarks: The type of location (Operating, Storeroom, Repair, et cettera). In Insert mode, the default type is Operating (or a synonym default supplied by your system administrator). Operating is the only type of location you can insert on the Operating Locations screen. When adding a location record, click Select Value to choose from a list of valid types.

plusgriskmethod.title: Risk Assessment Method
plusgriskmethod.remarks: The method used to assess this location for risk (for example, RCM, RBI, or FMECA).

storeroomparent.title: Parent Storeroom
storeroomparent.remarks: The parent storeroom of the current storeroom.

bimusage.title: BIM Location type
bimusage.remarks: Describes how a location is used and controls COBie export behavior

plusmrule.title: Maintenance Rule
plusmrule.remarks: Indicates whether this component is critical to the successful operation of the plant and therefore subject to a regulatory maintenance rule. A maintenance rule typically states that when the performance or condition of a component does not meet established goals, appropriate corrective action must be taken.

modelid.title: Import ID
modelid.remarks: Import ID Typically from a BIM model or COBie data set

shiptoaddresscode.title: Ship to Address
shiptoaddresscode.remarks: Default address code to ship items to when reorders are processed for this storeroom. Click the Select Value button to choose a shipping code.

mrefrecordid.title: Real Estate and Facilities record ID
mrefrecordid.remarks: Internal Real Estate and Facilities ID of the location

plusgrbicode.title: Risk-Based Inspection Code
plusgrbicode.remarks: The risk-based inspection code that is associated with the location. Valid values are in the PLUSGRBICODE domain.

estendoflife.title: Estimated EOL
estendoflife.remarks: The date when the location reaches its end of life. This date is based on the condition of the location.

plusgfmstart.title: Start
plusgfmstart.remarks: The date when the failure analysis is set to begin.

saddresscode.title: Service Address
saddresscode.remarks: The address code identifies a service address. It must be unique by site for each service address.

plusgpolicyid.title: Operating Policy
plusgpolicyid.remarks: The unique identifier of an operating policy.

plusgopstate.title: Operating State
plusgopstate.remarks: The current operating state of the location or valve.

plusgfunction.title: Function
plusgfunction.remarks: The organizational function that is responsible for this location. Valid values are in the PLUSGFUNCTION domain.

plusgsafecrielem.title: Safety Critical Element
plusgsafecrielem.remarks: A reference to any element that is critical to safety and that is associated with a regulation. A performance standard that regulates the emission of hazardous substances can be a type of critical-safety reference.

plusgbarrier.title: Barrier
plusgbarrier.remarks: The barrier that is associated with the location.

plusgexregistered.title: Ex/ATEX
plusgexregistered.remarks: Specifies if the location is Ex/ATEX. If the check box is selected, you must specify a value in the corresponding Ex/ATEX standard field.

plusgisolevelplant.title: Level 4 - Plant or Unit
plusgisolevelplant.remarks: The ISO 14224 plant or unit type. Valid values are in the PLUSGISO14224PLANT domain.

plusgra.title: Generation Risk Assessment
plusgra.remarks: Generation Risk Assessment code. This value, determined by plant engineering, is a statistical measure of the impact the component's failure will have on the ability of the plant to generate electricity.

plusgenvcrielem.title: Environmentally Critical Element
plusgenvcrielem.remarks: A reference to any element that is critical to the environment, and that is associated with a regulation.

plusgisolevelsys.title: Level 5 - System
plusgisolevelsys.remarks: The ISO 14224 main system of the plant. Valid values are in the PLUSGISO14224SYS domain.

plusgmainstrategy.title: Maintenance Strategy
plusgmainstrategy.remarks: Identifies the maintenance strategy for this location (for example, run to fail, condition-based, or campaign maintenance).

plusrev.title: Revision
plusrev.remarks: The current revision of the location.

plusgriskassessid.title: Risk Assessment Unique Identifier
plusgriskassessid.remarks: The unique identifier of the risk assessment.

health.title: Health
health.remarks: The health score for the location. This score is calculated and applied to the location from the Reliability Engineer work center.

isrepairfacility.title: Is a Repair Facility
isrepairfacility.remarks: Specifies whether the location is a repair facility location. Repair facilities can take ownership of work orders from multiple sites in the same organization. User security can then be configured to give permissions to view work orders in multiple sites if the work orders are owned by the repair facility.

plusgphysloc.title: Physical Location
plusgphysloc.remarks: A description of the physical location in the plant.

plusgispassvalve.title: Passing Valve
plusgispassvalve.remarks: Specifies whether the valve is closed properly and that it is not leaking fluids or gases.

autowogen.title: Automatically Generate Work Orders
autowogen.remarks: Flag that indicates whether to start the wogen process when meter frequency is reached for a location

bimimportsrc.title: Import source
bimimportsrc.remarks: The external source for the data in this record such as a COBie sheet or an IFC class name

plusgbennum.title: Loss Reference
plusgbennum.remarks: The loss record that defines the production loss associated with work at this location.

plusgpipinspectby.title: Inspected By
plusgpipinspectby.remarks: The person who inspected the pipe.

plusglocknum.title: Lock Number
plusglocknum.remarks: The identifier of the lock that is applied.

reordfromstore.title: Reorder Storeroom
reordfromstore.remarks: The storeroom that all the items in the current storeroom are reordered from.

plusgcurlockstate.title: Lock State
plusgcurlockstate.remarks: The current state of the lock. For example, indicates whether the asset or location is locked in an open or closed position.

shiptolaborcode.title: Ship to Labor
shiptolaborcode.remarks: Default labor code to ship items to when reorders are processed for this storeroom. Click the Select Value button to choose a labor code.

plusgfmtype.title: Failure Analysis Type
plusgfmtype.remarks: The type of procedural analysis that must be done to identify the potential causes of failures at this location. An FMEA analysis is done at the functional level. An FMECA analysis extends the FMEA analysis by including a criticality analysis, which identifies the potential causes of failures and the consequences of failures. Criticality-based maintenance identifies which locations are critical and what the impact would be if the locations were to fail. Criticality-based maintenance also informs procurement strategy so that inventories, and the costs associated with keeping them, are reduced but not at the expense of increased downtime.

plusgpiplineclass.title: Line Class
plusgpiplineclass.remarks: The classification to which the pipe is assigned.

isdefault.title: Default Storeroom
isdefault.remarks: Specifies whether this storeroom is the default storeroom for the site. If the check box is selected, Maximo reserves items for this storeroom if a job plan or work order does not specify a storeroom. If the check box is cleared (the default), this storeroom is not used as the default storeroom when work orders are generated with no storeroom information.

reordfromstoresiteid.title: Reorder Site
reordfromstoresiteid.remarks: The site of the storeroom that all the items in the current storeroom are reordered from.

oldshrinkageacc.title: Old Shrinkage Account
oldshrinkageacc.remarks: Last shrinkage cost account for manual adjustment for inventory quantity.

plusgdrawingref.title: Drawing Reference
plusgdrawingref.remarks: The identifier of a plant reference drawing.

plusgoutageconseq.title: Outage Consequence
plusgoutageconseq.remarks: The impact on production if there is an outage at this location.

mrefloctype.title: Real Estate and Facilities location Type
mrefloctype.remarks: System identified as Real Estate and Facilities system and define top level property or building

plusgmttr.title: MTTR
plusgmttr.remarks: The mean time to repair for the location, in hours. The value must be an integer.

plusgrisktype.title: Risk Type
plusgrisktype.remarks: The risk type for this location (for example, health and safety, environment, or production).

plusgpandidnumber.title: P and ID
plusgpandidnumber.remarks: The plant Piping and Instrumentation Diagram number.

plusgfmpersonid.title: Failure Analysis Leader ID
plusgfmpersonid.remarks: The person who is leading the failure analysis effort.

plusgiso14224plant.title: Plant or Unit Detail
plusgiso14224plant.remarks: Detail about the plant or unit.

plusgpipinspectdate.title: Last Inspection Date/Time
plusgpipinspectdate.remarks: The date and time when the pipe was last inspected.

plusgriskassessed.title: Risk Assessed Location
plusgriskassessed.remarks: Specifies whether this location has been assessed for risk. If the check box is selected, this location has been assessed. If the check box is cleared, this location has not been assessed.

pluscritical.title: Criticality
pluscritical.remarks: Enter how critical this component is to the success or safety of the plant. This code determines if the item is critical, non-critical, or has been designated as Run-To-Failure (RTF). RTF is normally used for items such as light bulbs that are normally replaced only when they fail. Identification and evaluation of the structures and components that are associated with the performance of the function. 1.  If a failure of the component or its structural supports defeats or degrades an important function or a function that is redundant to an important function, then it is a critical component 2.  In between the categories of critical and run-to-failure, there are a number of SSCs for which cost-effective preventive maintenance makes sense. 3.  A run-to-failure component is one for which the risks and consequences of failure are acceptable without any predictive or repetitive maintenance being performed and there is not a simple, cost-effective method to extend the useful life of the component. (Industry Reference: INPO AP913 r1 2001)

plusgpipinspectbyid.title: Inspected By ID
plusgpipinspectbyid.remarks: The person who inspected the pipe.

plusghistoricmtbf.title: Historic MTBF
plusghistoricmtbf.remarks: The historic mean time between failures for the location, in hours. The value must be an integer.

plusgopenomuid.title: Open Unique Idenfitier
plusgopenomuid.remarks: The open unique identifier provided to an external system by Maximo

islocked.title: Locked
islocked.remarks: Indicates that the lock is applied to the location or valve, and the new state is applied.

plusgreplacecost.title: Replacement Cost
plusgreplacecost.remarks: The cost to replace the particular unit of plant that is defined by the location, in base currency. This cost is used in the calculation of defect density in the Improvements application.

plusgleaking.title: Leaking
plusgleaking.remarks: Indicates whether the location or the asset at the location is leaking.

hasparent.title: Has Parent
hasparent.remarks: Does this location belong to a parent location?

lhancestor.title: Ancestor Location
lhancestor.remarks: Parent Ancestor that contains the Service Address information.

glaccount.title: GL Account
glaccount.remarks: The GL account code for this location. Click Select Value to view or select from a list of valid GL accounts.

curvaracc.title: Currency Variance Account
curvaracc.remarks: Account containing the differences between the PO price and the invoice price that result from changes in the exchange rate. If, as a result of an exchange rate change, the invoice cost in base currency exceeds the receipt cost in base currency, then the transaction amount is positive. If the invoice cost in base currency is less than the receipt cost in base currency, then the transaction amount is negative. This account is paired with the GL control account; when the currency variance account's value decreases, the inventory control account's value decreases. Variance accounts track price variances by storeroom location, not by item. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

plusgtempuntil.title: Temporary Until
plusgtempuntil.remarks: The date until which the location retains its temporary status. After the temporary status expires, you can opt not to use it.

controlacc.title: GL Control Account
controlacc.remarks: Default GL account that Maximo applies to items in this storeroom during GL transactions such as issues, returns, receipts, transfers, and adjustments. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

plusgaccessreq.title: Access Requirements
plusgaccessreq.remarks: Special requirements that are needed to access this area. Valid values are in the PLUSGACCESSREQ domain.

plusgdateofprediction.title: Date of Prediction
plusgdateofprediction.remarks: The date when the predicted mean time between failures was specified.

plusgsafetycrit.title: Safety Critical
plusgsafetycrit.remarks: Specifies whether this location is a safety critical area. If the check box is selected, this location is a safety critical area. If the check box is cleared, this location is not a safety critical area.
